title: GTA6 Developer Rockstar HR Manager Testifies in Union Trial Amid Layoff Allegations
description: Rockstar Games faces an ongoing union-busting trial as an HR manager claims he had little interest in unionisation evidence before substantial layoffs.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## Rockstar HR Manager Testifies in Ongoing Union Trial

As anticipation continues to build worldwide for the upcoming release of GTA6, its developer, Rockstar Games, finds itself in the midst of a high-profile legal battle. According to a recent report by gaming outlet Eurogamer, new witness testimonies have emerged in the ongoing legal case of Rockstar Games vs Garland & Others.

The trial centers around accusations of union-busting following the decision by the developer to lay off a substantial number of employees who were members of a union Discord server.

## The HR Testimony and Details

During the recent hearings, one of Rockstar's human resources managers took the stand. According to the testimony, the HR witness stated that he had "little interest" in evidence regarding unionization efforts that had been sent to him by an anonymous employee prior to the wave of layoffs.

This testimony has become a focal point as the trial heats up, providing a glimpse into the internal communications and management handling of employee organizing efforts at the major gaming studio.

## Context and Industry Impact

As the studio behind the highly anticipated GTA6, any internal controversy at Rockstar naturally captures the spotlight within the gaming community. While this trial deals specifically with labor rights, union membership, and employment terminations rather than gameplay mechanics or release schedules, it highlights the ongoing discussions surrounding working conditions within the AAA video game industry. Observers and analysts continue to monitor how these workplace dynamics might influence the broader corporate environment at the developer.

## Editor's Take

Labor disputes and union-busting allegations are serious matters that can significantly impact a studio's reputation. While fans remain laser-focused on GTA6 updates, the well-being and rights of the developers behind the scenes are equally crucial to the industry's sustainable future.
